english: Now, what kind of world is this, I wonder?
Meow.
Woof, woof!
Hm? You feel nostalgic, you say?\nAlpha and Beta's noses are reliable, but...
Hmm, so this is Rem's world?
Rem should just call\nsomeone she knows.
Right. Let's find a phone booth.
I've been wondering, Rem —\ndon't you have a cell phone?
We don't have small phones\nlike in your worlds, Aria-chan, Rinin-chan.\nWe do have big radio-like things, though.
A radio... so no cell phones...
Cell phone? What's that?
Is a cell phone some kind of special weapon?
Hmm, I don't really know either...?
You guys don't know either?\nComplicated!
Strange...
Yeah, not a soul around.\nIt's a main street but dead silent — creepy.
It's like, like a ghost town...
Uhyah — this is what they call\na ghost town, right?
Bad vibes.
Speaking of, Aria —\nyou're the dual-blade, dual-gun wielder,\n'Aria the Quadra,' right?
So what? Got a problem with that?
Then I'd be 'Rinin of Twin Blades and Twin Cannons'!\nKouryuu has the Soutengagetsu and Ryuuhou on both shoulders,\nso that works, right?
Wow! Rinin-san sounds strong too!
Rejected. I'll allow twin blades, but\nthe cannons are just stuck on there —\nyou don't wield them by hand.
Why not!?\nDoes it have to be by hand?
If that counts, what about Cecilia?
Bits can't be used at the same time as melee weapons!
Now now, let's call it even on both sides\nand make up.
How does calling it even make us make up!?
Epithets like that are nice!\n'Hand Power,' 'Escape King,'\n'The Legendary Spoon-Bender'!
What IS that naming sense...
If I gave out epithets,\nAria-san'd be 'the Tiny Terror,' and\nRinin-san... 'the Koshi-an-Colored Typhoon'!
Rejected!!
I got in touch with Inspector Sakaki.\nThis looks like the world I was in.
So we made it back, huh.
That's good, but\nthings look pretty bad.
Come to think of it,\nall kinds of incidents were happening, right?
Yeah, incidents galore.\n'Spirited-away' cases, the 'Doppelganger Phenomenon,'\n'Unknown Creature Attacks,' one after another.
The police can't keep up, apparently.
We came back\nat a terrible time...
Wrong! It's the opposite!\nTimes like these are when\nyou can gain the most!
Right, catch shrimp using a sea bream!
That's not how it goes...\nI think the sea bream and shrimp are reversed...
Right, high risk, high return!\nWhere there's a chance, there's peril!
There shouldn't BE peril...
What's youth? Never giving up!\nSo we're going\non the offensive too.
You've got a plan?
Yes. The victims of the 'Sudden Street Sleep' incident —\nthe one that got you too, Aria-chan —\nkeep increasing.
So there's a Doctor Shinigami guy\nwho tried to kill me!
Right. But like you saw, Aria-chan,\ndealing with Doctor Shinigami\nis dangerous and difficult.
I know.\nEven after I put a hole through him, he didn't die.
He doesn't die... no way!
He really doesn't die.
W-w-we really saw it!
Wasn't it some kind of trick?\nIf you make people believe he's immortal,\nyou gain the edge in the mind games.
From my perspective, Rinin-chan's Kouryuu\nis unbelievable too.
But go to another world and it exists\nlike it's the most normal thing.\nIf you're trapped by common sense, you'll never solve the mystery.
Got it. Gotta keep an open mind.
So, do you have a countermeasure for Doctor Shinigami?
Yes. According to the police,\nthey've more or less pinpointed\nDoctor Shinigami's hiding place.
They're evacuating nearby residents\nand setting up a caution zone, apparently.
Then we just storm the place!
Only after the evacuation's done.\nFighting without countering the Sudden Street Sleep\nwould be bad.
After Doctor Shinigami appeared,\nI was put to sleep in seconds.\nGo in with no plan and we'll be put to sleep easy.
IS units deploy barriers for space activity,\nso I'm fine!
We can take measures, but\nthe problem is if anyone besides us has fallen asleep —\nthat'd be bad.
Doctor Shinigami can enter people's dreams.\nSo as long as someone's asleep somewhere,\nhe can flee into dreams freely.
What!? That's beyond cheating!
See how dangerous he is?\nUnless there are no people around,\nwe can't fight him.
Right. That's the minimum condition.\nRem, when's the evacuation done?
Tomorrow at the earliest, I think.\nLet's wait at my office until then.
Huh, so Rem really was a detective.
First-time clients always stare\nwhen they see me,\nso I'm used to that reaction.
So you run a detective agency as your job?\nHow old are you, Rem...?
You mustn't ask a lady that.
But you look younger than me —\nyou and Aria both.
I'm a second-year in high school!
Awww, I'm younger.
Nice! Age-appropriate!
Huh, I'm younger too!
That's weird!\nWhy are you so developed!!
([CLAUDE],\nwhat's your preferred age?)
'How old' — what?
Quit that weird muttering!\nIt's seriously creepy.
S-sorry!\nI'll go make some tea...
Anyway Rem, tell me what you know\nabout this Doctor Shinigami guy.
Okay... first, hear this knowing\nthere's a lot we don't know —\nDoctor Shinigami is a villain of unknown identity.
He's probably not a normal human.\nI've dealt him the finishing blow three times,\nbut he keeps coming back.
You're seriously saying that?\nAnd the dream-entering stuff earlier —\noutrageous.
Both are fact.
He got into my dreams.\nAnd I shot him point-blank, but\nhe vanished laughing — seems he's alive.
That's straight out of a horror movie...
Didn't you know yet, Rinin-chan?\nDoctor Shinigami is a repeat offender —\na serial grotesque-murderer who specializes in beautiful girls.
Hey, you're not just making up crazy stuff\nto scare me, are you!?
Unfortunately, it's fact.
I-it's terrifying...
He's one of those villains.\nHe uses stuff more like sorcery\nthan magic.
How do you catch a guy like that?
Honestly, capturing him is hard.\nDoctor Shinigami isn't something\nhuman law can judge.
So we have to beat him?
If we can.
You've beaten him a few times, right, Rem?
Yes.\nBut I can't let my guard down.
(If anything, I'm not sure I can win as I am now...)
For now, we'll take anti-hypnosis measures.\nOther than that: never show an opening, no matter what.\nNever miss a chance to take him down. Got it?
Confirming:\nwe don't have to arrest him?
Unfortunately, a prison he can't break out of\nhasn't been invented yet.
Roger.
Even if I split his skull with the Soutengagetsu,\nwould he still live, I wonder...
Even if you think you've beaten him, don't let your guard down.
Doctor Shinigami's hideout\nis somewhere in this district.
The evacuation is done per police instructions.\nNow we just find Doctor Shinigami.
Unyuu, where could he be?
Mou, it's pretty big —\nhow do we search it?
Don't think you can escape\nKouryuu's hyper-sensor!
What's that...?
The hyper-sensor is\nan IS sight-and-hearing enhancement.
With Kouryuu deployed,\nfrom the top of a building I can see\nsplit ends on people's eyelashes on the ground!
Amazing! Like an African's eyesight!
Hey, isn't that comparison weird?
So, with that hyper-sensor thing,\nwere you tracking him?
Huh?
I've been waiting... fufufu.
Ehh!? Where were you hiding!?
Sight is the easiest sense to fool.\nParalyzing animals' sense of smell\ntakes far more care.
Mnyau!?
Wau!?
Alpha and Beta didn't notice at all.\nDoctor Shinigami... you are...!
Rem, you haven't forgotten\nwhat my power is, have you?
The power of... dreams...!!
Yes. Before the power of dreams, guns and swords are powerless.\nShall we test it?
Of course!\nI've got lots to ask you.\nLike your connection to Mine Riko!
You've taken so many girls' lives!\nI can't forgive someone like you!!
Don't get heated!\nCarefully, surely corner him!
Try it. The power of dreams...\nI'll remind you, Rem!
Let me say this first: don't you run!\nIf you're not afraid of me, settle this here!
...Very well. I'll show you I'm superior\neven outside the dream world!
Wow! A lovey one appeared!
Ugeeh, more nasty-feeling ones!
Seconds are free. Hahaha!!
How does it feel, fighting a battle you can't win?
You won't know till you try!
You know. You must know\nhow vast the gap between us is.\nFufufu...
Don't laugh!
Hou... I didn't expect this much!
Give it up, Doctor Shinigami!
It can't be helped... I'll withdraw for now.
You're running!? Like hell I'll let you!
You can never capture me.\nBecause I have a 'hideout.' If I just get there...\nfarewell!
That light!?
Like hell! Charging!!
You're not getting away!!
Yeah!
Charging in!!
//END
